Class DataRepository

java.lang.Object
bank.persistence.DataRepository
public class DataRepository extends Object
============================================================================ DataRepository.java Owner: John (smartdude879@gmail.com) ============================================================================ ROLE: The single "front door" to the bank's persisted state. Everyone else (AuthService, TransactionService, InterestCalculator) talks to this class — never to JsonStore directly. USAGE PATTERN: DataRepository repo = new DataRepository(); repo.load(); // call once at startup ... repo.findCustomer("1001"); // used by AuthService repo.save(); // call after every change WHY THIS WRAPPER EXISTS: If we ever swap JSON for a database, only THIS class changes. The rest of the app keeps working unchanged. ============================================================================

  • Method Details

    • load

      public void load()
      Loads bank state from disk. Call once at program startup. If the file is missing or corrupted the bank is initialised empty.

    • save

      public void save()
      Persists the current in-memory bank state to disk. Errors are logged — the program never crashes from a save failure.

    • findCustomer

      public Customer findCustomer(String customerId)
      Finds a customer by their ID.
      Parameters:
      customerId - the customer's unique ID
      Returns:
      the matching customer, or null if no such customer exists

    • allCustomers

      public List<Customer> allCustomers()
      Returns every customer in the bank. Used by InterestCalculator to loop over everyone.

    • addCustomer

      public void addCustomer(Customer customer)
      Adds a new customer to the bank. Throws if a customer with that ID already exists.
